body.prose:
To publish is to upload the objects the remote does not have, which is always safe since the same object is always the same file, and then to move the ref, but only if it still names the commit the publisher started from. If someone else moved it first, nothing is lost: the publisher's commits stand in the store, and the two lines meet by a merge, which is [still open](ref:01M6F8G0M0D9XYVG6X8PKDAYE2).

A bundle, if one is wanted, is made at publishing, from the objects, by whoever publishes.

*Reasoned, the session's, 2026-11-01.*
body.title: Publishing adds files and moves the ref
